AppFunctionAppMetadata.app:instructions: Intelligent Search searches this phone offline. Use searchApps to find an installed app by name and get its package name to open it, searchContacts to find a contact's phone number by name or number, and calculate for math, number base and unit conversions such as 100 km to miles. Nothing leaves the device; hidden apps are never returned, and contacts are returned only if the user allowed sharing them with assistants.
